_doc: Non-Rust and cross-package inputs of build units, read by scripts/build-key.py.
packages.<crate>: repository files (or directories) the crate reads from outside its own directory
(include_str!/include_bytes!, bindgen wit paths). The compiler's dep-info proves each of these;
an undeclared cross-package read yields no key (miss) until it is listed here.
units.<package>/<kind>: inputs the compiler cannot see, hashed into that unit's key:
paths (files or directories, repository-relative) and env (variable names).
